messages:
Alex P: Heads-up — I started a tiny PR to clarify per-route batching overrides in the Optimize Toolkit docs and noticed two things: the quant profiles anchor is 404 and the Python SDK example doesn't show explicit KV cache hints. Can someone eyeball?
Maria L: thanks for flagging. PR link?
Alex P: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 — small change, adds a TS + Py snippet and a note about when overrides are applied.
Ryan K: looked — the anchor break is from a renamed heading (we moved 'Quantization profiles' -> 'Quantization profiles (legacy)'). I'll fix the link in the TOC.
Sophie R: For KV cache, can we add a short example showing prefix caching vs full-session caching? quick snippet like:
```python
# Python SDK: per-route cache hint
client.infer(
  model="redwood/7b",
  route="chat/low-latency",
  prompt="Summarize...",
  cache_hint={"type":"prefix","keys":["user_id","session_id"]}
)
```
Kevin T: Yep that's useful. Also suggest calling out that cache_hint is advisory — runtime may ignore for strict SLO routes.
Alex P: good point, I'll add a one-liner about advisory behavior.
Ben C: small nit: the typescript snippet in the PR uses `.send()` but our SDK uses `client.generate()` in the latest examples. Should update for consistency.
Maria L: I can swap the TS snippet to use generate(). Also we should add a migration note: 'if you relied on per-call .send() hooks, use generate({route, cacheHint})'.
DocsBot: Reminder: docs routes must include a code sample for both Python and TS when editing the Optimize Toolkit section. (auto-note)
Kevin T: There's also an edge-case: quant profile names can include region suffixes (e.g., `quant-v1-us`). We should add that in the troubleshooting FAQ so people don't paste an exact name and get a mismatch.
Sophie R: Can someone add a one-line test that verifies the link isn't 404? e.g. a tiny CI check that fetches the heading anchor. I can add it in a follow-up.
Alex P: great — I'll update PR: fix TOC anchor, swap TS `.send()` -> `.generate()`, add KV cache advisory, and a short troubleshooting bullet for region-suffixed quant names.
Ryan K: sgtm. tagging @Ben C and @Sophie R for review when ready. :thumbsup:
Ben C: happy to review after changes. I can also run a quick lint pass for code formatting.
Maria L: once merged, I'll add a redirect from the old heading to avoid more broken links.
Alex P: done — pushed edits and updated PR description with the test plan. thanks everyone.
Ben C: looked — LGTM, a couple of whitespace fixes, then merge.
Alex P: merged. closing thread. :party-parrot:
